title: Fill book workspace height to viewport bottom
user_summary: 打开小说后左侧章节列表与正文区域未铺满视口底部，下方留白，章节与正文无法滚动到屏幕最下方。
technical_summary: book-shell used calc(100vh-76px) while already inside app main 1fr; book-shell-body was not a flex container so book-shell-main flex:1 and nested height:100% collapsed to content height, leaving a large bottom gap. Fix: app-shell-simplified height 100vh; main flex column; book/results shells flex:1 height 100%; book-shell-body display flex; workspace/reader min-height 0 fill.
acceptance_criteria: Opening a book fills chapter nav and reader to the bottom of the viewport
Chapter list independently scrolls within the filled left pane
verification_evidence: Screenshot: beige nav and reader ended mid-viewport with large white gap under both columns.
Root: book-shell-body not flex; height:100% on workspace unresolved; vh calc double-counted chrome.
